theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Set for Muted Open, Oil Holds Losses: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks in Asia were set for a muted open Tuesday as investors weighed a rebound in US equities against lingering uncertainty over the Middle East and whether the artificial intelligence-fueled rally has further to run. Oil held Monday’s losses.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 4
top_news.summary: Oil was steady after its biggest drop in a week, as President Donald Trump said his latest offer of talks is Tehran’s “last chance” and that he expects a full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

top_news.title: Big Take: War Is Good For Big Oil's Profits
top_news.summary: With Exxon and Chevron reporting their biggest profits in years, oil reporter Mitchell Ferman on why US gasoline prices are still so high. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Situational Awareness' 439% Return Was the Warning
top_news.summary: Bloomberg Opinion Columnist Aaron Brown discusses his latest piece on the collapse of AI Hedge Fund Situational Awareness. He argues "The easy story is another tech wunderkind flying too close to the sun. The more useful one is that the 439% return was a warning, not a triumph." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: NYC Rent Freeze May Hit Mortgage Bonds
top_news.summary: A $506 million bet on thousands of New York rent-stabilized apartments has already soured for bond investors, and Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s rent freeze is threatening to make it worse. Ran Eliasaf, Founder & Managing Partner of Northwind Group, discusses the needs in the NYC housing market and the possible impact of the city's recent moves to make it more affordable and levy new taxes. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Amazon Crosses $1T Valuation, Boeing Has Biggest Gain Since December | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Treasuries Climb to Start Week on Oil, Bessent’s Yen Pledge
top_news.summary: Treasuries are starting the week on an optimistic note, buoyed by tumbling oil prices and assurances that tens of billions of dollars in Japanese currency interventions won’t be funded from sales of US government debt.

top_news.title: Stocks Close Near Record as Amazon Tops $3 Trillion Market Cap
top_news.summary: US stocks rose on the first trading day of the month as attention turned to this week’s heavy slate of earnings reports.

top_news.title: Fund Launches and Leveraged ETFs Flood The Industry | ETF IQ 8/3/2026
top_news.summary: "Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: Vident Asset Management President Amrita Nandakumar, Matthews CIO & Portfolio Manager Sean Taylor, Amplify ETFs Founder & CEO Christian Magoon, and Capital Group Head of Global Product Strategy and Development Holly Framsted.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Iran War Risk Still Important in Background, Says Torsten Slok
top_news.summary:
Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo, said that while AI and the Fed may be issues more at the forefront of the economic conversation, risk from the Iran war and its subsequent impact on fuel stores remains an important factor in the background. 
Slok also commented the possibility that the Fed may have fewer meetings, saying that market will still try to price the Fed regardless of the schedule.  (Source: Bloomberg)
